section_summary.extract_value: This section presents convergent validity results for the BAS-2 across three countries (Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden) with separate analyses for boys and girls. Body appreciation showed moderate to strong positive correlations with self-esteem, psychological well-being, and intuitive eating across all groups. Weak negative correlations were found between BAS-2 and BMI, with statistical significance varying by country and gender: significant in Portugal for both genders (girls: r = .14; boys: r = −.33), but not significant in Denmark or Sweden.
